decision.explanation: Both awards are directly supported by the original sources. Document d1 explicitly states that Vicente Cárcel Orti was awarded the National Prize of East Germany for his contributions to East German history. Document d2 provides detailed evidence that he received the title of 'Dearest Son' (Hijo Predilecto) from the Autonomous Community of Valencia in recognition of his historical and ecclesiastical work. These are two distinct awards from separate contexts and are both valid answers.
